title: Advanced reactivity-based sequencing methods for mRNA epitranscriptome profiling
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00215F, Review Article
Open Access

Zhihe Cai, Peizhe Song, Kemiao Yu, Guifang Jia
This review explores the latest progress in reactivity-based sequencing methods for nine key mRNA modifications, focusing on their potential features for precise and sensitive mapping and quantification.
